payload.description: Initial matched model-backed evaluation completed on 6 October 2026: six counterbalanced pairs, 24 fresh gpt-6.1-sol/high turns, fixed prompts and external scoring. Both arms passed 48/48 functional cases, recovered 24/24 contract fields and retained 6/6 deferred identifiers. Median time 164.19 s without DIP versus 360.84 s with DIP. All outcomes, source artifacts, reported token usage, task counts/status and two infrastructure attempts are retained in docs/benchmarks/model-controlled.md. Independent replay reproduced all 24 stages and aggregate totals. No productivity advantage is claimed. Semantic duplicate judgments, implicit reminders, concurrency and long-running development remain separate evaluations. Follow-up overhead optimization is DIP-B01.
